name: Grade 7 IT Practice: April Week 5 - Calibration
description: Practice words for speed, time, distance, and accuracy.

words.definition: A movement value adjusted during calibration to improve accuracy.
words.example: The team lowered the speed so the robot would not overshoot.
Changing the time helped the robot stop closer to the line.

words.definition: How far apart two things are.
words.example: The robot measured the distance between two checkpoints.

words.definition: The way something moves or points.
words.example: The robot changed direction at the corner.

words.definition: Adjusting something so it works more accurately.
words.example: Calibration adjusted the movement until the robot reached the target.

words.definition: How close a result is to what was expected.
words.example: Accuracy improved when the robot stopped near the same mark twice.
